title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: Rust build artifacts committed to repo
description:
Commit d83cbc5 includes Rust build artifacts under `rust/target/debug/`:
- `rust/target/debug/deps/lichen_gateway-f1ce66f1c4497e73.d` (dep file)
- `rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh-working/dep-graph.part.bin` (4.2MB binary)
- `rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh.lock` (lock file)

Root cause: `.gitignore` has no `target/` exclusion for the Rust workspace. Fix:
1. Add `target/` to `.gitignore` (or `rust/.gitignore`)
2. `git rm --cached` the committed build artifacts
3. Amend commit to remove them
